summary: Join our comprehensive Safety and Security Management Training Course. Equip yourself with vital knowledge to manage risks and ensure safety effectively.
lede: Safety and security management combines hazard assessment, threat analysis, and control measures to protect people, assets, and operations. For health and safety officers, security supervisors, facilities managers, and operational leaders, the training focuses on assessing integrated risks, checking whether controls work, and preparing coordinated responses. Participants practise building risk registers and bow-tie analyses, planning emergency arrangements, investigating incidents, and tracking corrective actions.
audienceIntro: This safety and security management course suits professionals who coordinate prevention, protection, emergency response, and operational assurance across workplaces, facilities, projects, and service environments.
prerequisites: No formal certification or technical background is required. You should have a basic understanding of workplace operations and be able to describe common hazards, security concerns, or emergency responsibilities in your organization. No coding or programming is required. A laptop is recommended for digital risk-register and dashboard exercises. Advanced analytics, AI-assisted monitoring, ISO 22301:2019, and ISO 19011:2018 content are addressed at conceptual and operational application levels, not the technical engineering level.
